Hope you're having a productive week.

I am reaching out regarding Azure Data Engineer opportunities at Microsoft. I bring 2.5 YOE specializing in Azure Databricks, PySpark, Delta Lake, and ADF across enterprise Medallion Lakehouses at CGI (PNC Bank GCC) and HFCL.

Lavkush Kumar

message_content:
Hi Senior,

I have been following Walmart Global Tech's engineering deliverables and wanted to reach out directly.

I am an Azure Data Engineer (2.5 YOE) building high-throughput Lakehouse data backbones (Azure Databricks, PySpark, Delta Lake, ADF, Kafka) at CGI (PNC Bank GCC).

What I can immediately deliver for your data platform:
1. Lakehouse Scaling: Hands-on experience architecting Medallion Lakehouses processing 2M+ events/day with Delta Lake ACID transactions, CDC ingestion, and schema enforcement.
2. Query & Pipeline Optimization: Deep PySpark & Spark SQL performance tuning (partition pruning, liquid clustering, broadcast joins), reducing ETL execution latencies by 35%.
3. Reliable DataOps: Production Terraform IaC and automated validation gates (Great Expectations, CI/CD), ensuring zero schema drift and high platform availability.

I am on a 15-day notice period and actively targeting ₹20–25 LPA Azure Data Engineering roles.

I would welcome a 10-minute technical chat to discuss your current data platform challenges and share how my background aligns with Walmart Global Tech's roadmap.

Best regards,
Lavkush Kumar
Phone: +91 9122036484 | Email: lavkushry@gmail.com | LinkedIn: linkedin.com/in/lavkushry
